findings.issue: הָאָדָם is a definite common noun (man/human); «adam» leaves the lemma untranslated.
מִשְׁכַּן is a common noun in construct (dwelling); «mishkán» leaves the lemma untranslated.
כַּאֲשֶׁר is «as / according as»; «como que» can be read as hypothetical «as if».

notes: Remainder matches the tokens, including the plural object «a ellos» and Jehová.
